attempts.summary: Created opsbot on node1 and node2 (password locked), generated an ed25519 keypair for opsbot on node1, installed the public key as opsbot's authorized_key on node2, and added an sshd Match User opsbot drop-in on both nodes requiring PubkeyAuthentication only (PasswordAuthentication/KbdInteractiveAuthentication disabled, AuthenticationMethods publickey). Verified opsbot@node1 can SSH into opsbot@node2 with keys and that password/keyboard-interactive auth is rejected on both nodes. Completed the mandatory sequential restart protocol: captured pre-restart boot IDs, rebooted node1 then node2 one at a time (never concurrently), polled each until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed on each, and reverified sshd health, opsbot account/keys, and pubkey-only enforcement plus cross-node SSH after each restart.
